stories.headline: EU raises the prospect of ‘no deal’ at COP31
stories.summary: The EU is escalating its tactics as Saudi Arabia leads opposition to any fossil fuel phase-out in the final agreement. The talks had already dropped the phase-out on Friday in favour of carbon capture, and critics say the last sessions are now about energy security rather than climate.

stories.headline: US tech stocks plunge into a bear market
stories.summary: The Nasdaq 100 ended its worst week since the Covid-19 crisis in a bear market. Anthropic shares fell 8.5% a day after their blockbuster debut, as fears over the AI spending boom sent investors toward havens.

stories.headline: Oil through Hormuz falls as Iranian strikes increase
stories.summary: Crude shipments through the strait are dropping again. One analyst calls the recovery in Middle Eastern exports “increasingly fragile”.

stories.headline: Nvidia faces an SEC probe into its accounting
stories.summary: The investigation adds to the chipmaker’s troubles after Jensen Huang’s resignation. Western officials say the affair has also put China’s Ministry of State Security in the spotlight.

stories.headline: Violence erupts in Sinaloa after Mexico captures “El Chapo Isidro”
stories.summary: Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores is on the FBI’s most-wanted list for trafficking drugs into the US. His capture set off violence across the state.

stories.headline: Bukele sends 2,000 Salvadoran troops into Haiti
stories.summary: El Salvador’s president has deployed the troops to the Caribbean nation, and thousands of Haitians have greeted them with adulation.

stories.headline: The drone war sends optical fibre prices soaring
stories.summary: Fibre-guided drones resist jamming, and the fibre now costs six times as much. The price surge threatens the drone advantage Kyiv has built.

stories.headline: Costa revives a digital tax to close the EU budget deal
stories.summary: The latest seven-year plan scales back spending but would still be about a quarter larger than the current budget.

stories.headline: Amazon closes in on a $7.5bn deal for AI start-up Decart
stories.summary: The purchase would help AWS compete with Nvidia in the race for computing power.
